data: Which of these methods shows the highest BLEU score after 20 iterations?

The question asks which method shows the highest BLEU score after 20 iterations. From the analysis of the figure, the green line represents the authoritarian method, the blue line represents the authoritative method, the red line represents the neglecting method, and the black line represents the permissive method. The green line is consistently above all other lines throughout the iterations, indicating that the authoritarian method has the highest BLEU score after 20 iterations. Therefore, the answer is the authoritarian method.
